replies.body:
Reports should be posted under this subforum http://avicus.net/forums?topic_id=47 

Also the "hacks" might just be a good combo. In my opinion this is not enough video proof for a punishment. Also how do you know both are "hackers" if you only provide proof of one killing you and even from that proof its barely visible if it is hacks or just a combo.

A small recommendation is also make your video unlisted on youtube. Not public since its a report and not private so staff can see when linked.
